text:
jasper: CI on main is red, looks like a secrets decrypt error in the deploy job. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: saw it in my PR too, failing at `decrypt_env_vars` step.

ci-bot: build #4821 failed: `Error: failed to decrypt secret: keyring: decryption failed (permission denied)`

kai: @maria can you paste the full runner log? might be a key access issue.

maria: pasted the relevant lines:```
2026-07-01T09:12:03Z runner: decrypt_env_vars: start
2026-07-01T09:12:03Z kms: request decrypt key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/inference-key
2026-07-01T09:12:03Z kms: 403 Forbidden
Error: Access denied for key version
```

olivia: we rotated the KMS key yesterday as part of the monthly rotation job. Did the rotation updater push the new envelope to repo secrets?

jasper: hmm, the rotation job should have updated the GitHub repo secret `ENCRYPTED_KEY_BLOB`. Maybe the service account the rotation job uses lost write perms on the repo.

maria: quick debug: can someone try a manual redeploy with the old key blob restored? I can do a bisect if reruns still fail.

kai: I can re-run the workflow but won't fix decrypt until secrets are updated. Requesting a repo secret update from infra. @olivia did the rotation job report any failures?

olivia: rotation job logs show success at 02:03 UTC but with a warning: `warning: github: failed to replace secret (403) - insufficient permissions`. The job then wrote to vault but couldn't push to GitHub.

jasper: that explains it. Vault has new ciphertext but GitHub still has old one; the runner tries to decrypt with the new KMS key and fails. Two immediate actions: 1) manually restore the old ciphertext in vault so CI can succeed, 2) fix rotation job perms and re-run.

deploy-bot: @infra-team action required: update GitHub repo secret write perms for rotation-sa. See run_id=20260701-rot-34.

maria: I'll restore the old blob from our backup snapshot and trigger a rerun in ~5m. Can someone own the perms fix?

kai: I can take the perms fix. I'll open a tiny PR to grant `secrets: write` to rotation-sa via org settings and add a check in the rotation job logs for 403s.

jasper: thanks. maria, ping when rerun completes. If rerun passes we still need the long-term fix in <48h.

maria: rerun triggered: https://github.com/redwood/inference/actions/runs/4822 — pinging here when green. :crossed_fingers: 

ci-bot: build #4822 started.

ci-bot: build #4822 succeeded.

maria: green. thanks all.

kai: PR opened to add perms + improve rotation error handling: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/1294 — adding reviewers @olivia @jasper.

jasper: nice. follow-up: can we add a small smoke-check in CI that attempts to decrypt a test secret post-rotation? prevents silent mismatch next time.

olivia: agreed — adding to rotation playbook and job. I'll also notify security about the temporary restore we did.

maria: leaving notes in the incident board: /board/incidents/2026-07-kms-rotation. Closing this thread once perms PR merges. :white_check_mark:
